scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev --schema=../prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=../prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset --schema=../prisma/schema.prisma --force
scripts.db:views: docker exec -i focuslens_postgres psql -U focuslens -d focuslens < prisma/views.sql
